source.note: Search summary (results: Deer Valley media room 29 Jun 2026 "Expanded Excellence" update, deervalley.com Explore the Mountain, Coleman Concierge, Park Record): for 2026-27 about 4,500 skiable acres and 209 runs; 32 aerial lifts (2 gondolas, 23 detachable and 7 fixed-grip chairlifts). The new Hail Peak Express (86 chairs, up to 2,400 skiers/hour; placed by helicopter in Sep 2026) adds about 200 acres and 7 runs for 2026-27. Ability split not captured.

character: A skiers-only resort (no snowboards) beside Park City, separately ticketed from Park City Mountain, known for extensive grooming and a service-focused approach. Its original terrain spreads from the Snow Park base up through Silver Lake to Empire Canyon, and it is in the middle of a multi-year expansion toward a new East Village base near Jordanelle Reservoir.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain is at the Snow Park base (the Wide West learning area) with more green runs around Silver Lake, and the resort runs its own ski school. Skiing only. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

source.note: TownLift (Sep 2026): "Deer Valley targets Dec. 5 opening as resort continues developing expanded terrain". Utah roundups list the same date as projected. Conditions permitting — confirm on deervalley.com.

Search summary: 2025-26 opening Dec. 6, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 opening-dates list) and an early closure on Mar. 29, 2026 because of unseasonably warm conditions (Deseret News, 26 Mar 2026: https://www.deseret.com/lifestyle/2026/03/26/utah-ski-season-snow-forecast-deer-valley-closing/).

season.notes: 2026-27: Deer Valley targets Dec. 5, 2026 (TownLift, Sep 2026). No 2026-27 closing date was found. 2025-26 closed early (Mar. 29, 2026) in a warm season, so that closing is not typical.

prices.note: 2026-27 peak-day adult ticket $349. Non-peak and advance-online prices were not captured. In spring 2026 Deer Valley ran $100 half-day tickets (TownLift/Powder, Mar 2026) — not a 2026-27 price.
